technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all MAs and Ichimoku cross-up, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83, Stoch 91) and weak ADX trend confirmation create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dips than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 70 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (328.48) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 70 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up with price above all major moving averages provides structural bullish setup, and extreme market fear (VIX 328) creates contrarian buy opportunity for risk-tolerant traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83, Stoch 91) combined with VIX crisis regime, weak ADX trend confirmation (16.85), zero fundamental conviction, and upcoming earnings event in 70 days create excessive pullback risk that outweighs technical structure.
